topic_title: Using Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to Learn Basic HTML
goal: Learn how to use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to ask questions about HTML, understand core concepts like headings, and generate sample web pages
technical_facts: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language
HTML is the standard language used to create web pages
The h1 element defines a top-level heading on a webpage
The h1 element represents the main heading while h2 elements represent secondary-level headings
Microsoft 365 Copilot can provide code examples and explanations through conversational queries

tasks.task_name: Open Copilot and Ask About HTML Basics
tasks.description: Start by opening Microsoft 365 Copilot and asking fundamental questions about HTML

steps.expected_outcome: Copilot interface is open and ready to accept questions

steps.action: Type a question in the chat box
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot responds with the definition: 'HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is the standard language used to create web pages.'

tasks.description: Ask Copilot to provide a concrete example of a basic HTML structure

steps.action: Type the next question in the chat
steps.details: Ask 'Show me a basic HTML page example.'
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot provides a sample HTML structure with , , , <body>, <h1>, and <p> elements

steps.details: The example should include a simple webpage with a title and heading
steps.expected_outcome: You understand the basic structure of an HTML document

tasks.description: Understand the specific purpose and usage of HTML heading elements

steps.expected_outcome: Copilot explains: 'The h1 element defines a top-level heading on a webpage.'

steps.details: Type 'What is the difference between h1 and h2?'
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot clarifies: 'The h1 element represents the main heading while h2 elements represent subheadings.'

steps.details: You now know that h1 is for main titles and h2 is for secondary sections
steps.expected_outcome: You can correctly use h1 and h2 elements in your own HTML pages

tasks.description: Use Copilot to create a practical example combining learned concepts

steps.details: Ask Copilot: 'Generate a sample web page using headings and paragraphs.'
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot generates a complete HTML page with proper heading hierarchy and paragraph content

steps.details: Examine how Copilot applied the h1, h2, and paragraph elements in context
steps.expected_outcome: You have a practical example to reference for your own HTML projects
